meta.explainer: The world board lists the deadliest crawlers. Each time play starts, the app rolls once: usually nobody visits this floor; otherwise one of the top 10 names may appear. The other nine stay off-map. Floor purses are smaller than the posted board gold — see Bounties for stats and portraits on the top twenty.

rows.name: Lucia Mar
rows.blurb: Two rottweilers. They sit until she points.
rows.voice: She talks to the dogs. "Cinder, sit. Soot — that one."
rows.quest: The board posts 5,000 on Lucia Mar. This floor pays 100 gp for her, dead, or for both dogs down and her walking into a pen.

rows.name: Hekla
rows.blurb: Shield up. One of hers is still in the door.
rows.voice: Quiet. "Sigrun, the door. I still have the shield."
rows.quest: The board posts 4,500 on Hekla. This floor pays 90 gp if she dies here, or if she leaves the floor in a pen.

rows.name: Prepotente
rows.blurb: A goat who ruins the plan by saying it.
rows.voice: He answers before you finish. "Wrong. The bridge isn't rotten. I checked."
rows.quest: The board posts 4,000 on Prepotente. This floor pays 80 gp for the goat, dead or penned. He is a crawler. He will tell you so.

rows.name: Florin
rows.blurb: Offers a split. Someone else holds the exit.
rows.voice: Barracks calm. "Ren has the exit. I have you. Rush me."
rows.quest: The board posts 3,500 on Florin. This floor pays 70 gp when he stops being a problem. He will offer you a worse problem first.

rows.name: Quan Ch
rows.blurb: Three taps. One hit. Then he leaves.
rows.voice: Three taps on the knife. Then, barely: "Ba."
rows.quest: The board posts 3,000 on Quan Ch. This floor pays 60 gp for him. He counts to three. You will hear it.

rows.name: Miss Quill
rows.blurb: Asks for a yes. The quills are the lesson.
rows.voice: Teacher voice. "Pick a word. Ade already picked his."
rows.quest: The board posts 2,750 on Miss Quill. This floor pays 55 gp. She will ask you something first. Answer, or don't.

rows.name: Gwendolyn Duet
rows.blurb: The number needs the light. She needs the watch.
rows.voice: Into the light first. "You're the audience. Camille, don't blink."
rows.quest: The board posts 2,500 on Gwendolyn Duet. This floor pays 50 gp. She is already performing. Decide if you are the audience.

rows.name: Signet
rows.blurb: Offers a kneel. The knife is the other deal.
rows.voice: She offers it like a chair. "Kneel, or don't. Jonah — not yet."
rows.quest: The board posts 2,250 on Signet. This floor pays 45 gp. She may offer a different contract. Hear it before you swing.

rows.name: Li Jun
rows.blurb: Already moving. Someone is filling the gap.
rows.voice: Already moving. "Pilar, the gap. I'm not stopping."
rows.quest: The board posts 2,000 on Li Jun. This floor pays 40 gp. He is looking for Li Na. She is not on this floor.

rows.name: Li Na
rows.blurb: She waits. The late hit is the one that matters.
rows.voice: Soft. "Go on. I'll wait."
rows.quest: The board posts 1,800 on Li Na. This floor pays 35 gp. She is looking for Li Jun. He is not on this floor.

rows.name: Elle McGibbons
rows.blurb: Crowd favorite who never wastes a moment.
rows.voice: Bright and fast, plays to the room. "Hi, everyone! Watch this. Don't blink."

rows.name: Daniel Bautista
rows.blurb: Dependable and frighteningly efficient.
rows.voice: Flat, polite, efficient. "Done. Next."

rows.name: Frank Q
rows.blurb: Shooter with a calm voice.
rows.voice: Calm and unhurried. "Easy now. One at a time."

rows.name: Maggie My
rows.blurb: Talker who can survive the answer.
rows.voice: Quick and teasing. Answers a question with a better question. "Is that really what you want to ask?"

rows.name: Katia Grim
rows.blurb: Adaptable crawler with iron resolve.
rows.voice: Level and stubborn. "I've done worse. I can do this."

rows.name: Rosa "Chainsaw" Delgado
rows.blurb: Never met a barricade she respected.
rows.voice: Cheerful and loud. "Doors are suggestions!"

rows.name: Big Tom Okafor
rows.blurb: Gentle voice and wrecking-ball shoulders.
rows.voice: Soft and kind. "Sorry about this. Please stand back."

rows.name: Dmitri Volkov
rows.blurb: Patient hunter with an accountant's memory.
rows.voice: Dry and quiet. Remembers every debt and every date. "You owe me four. I counted."

rows.name: Sister Agnes Mbeki
rows.blurb: Merciful until mercy stops working.
rows.voice: Gentle and warm until it is not. "Mercy first. Then the staff."

rows.name: Kenji "Two-Tap" Mori
rows.blurb: Every motion measured twice.
rows.voice: Measured and exact. "Measure twice. Tap twice."
